summary: Completed phases 10-17 of 26 (waves 4-6, this dispatch's explicit scope), resuming from the phases-1-9 continuation handoff. Introduced the core theory registry with lazy resolution (Phase 10); fixed bimodal's test_example_range gap and unified all get_theory() signatures (Phase 11); moved theory-aware helpers from utils/ to a new upper-layer model_checker/api.py (Phase 12); rederived builder/'s theory identity entirely from the registry, fixing a live drift bug (Phase 13); normalized imposition, establishing the normalization template (Phase 14); fully reclassified jupyter/ and eliminated every hardcoded theory-name literal in the package (Phase 15); relocated builder/z3_utils.py into iterate/ (Phase 16); and split exclusion's 600-line semantic/__init__.py into core.py/model.py/proposition.py (Phase 17). The core/theory_lib layering test (code/tests/test_layering.py) is now fully GREEN repo-wide -- both RED-baseline assertions from Phase 9 pass with zero violations.

blockers.description: Phase 2's full serial oracle suite run (550 tests) remains unattempted since the phases-1-9 dispatch -- this dispatch did not attempt it either, per the orchestrator's explicit instruction not to spend this dispatch re-running it. Collection count (550) and the 5 xfail(strict=True) line locations remain pinned and verified clean. A future session with pytest-xdist available, or dedicated/isolated resources, should re-attempt the full oracle run and commit baselines/oracle-run.txt + baselines/junit-oracle.xml to fully close Phase 2 (still marked [PARTIAL] in the plan).

Phase 18 (Normalize logos -- split semantic.py into a package) is the next wave-7 phase and is a materially larger, higher-risk unit of work than any phase completed in this dispatch: logos's semantic.py is 1283 lines and is the most widely-imported module in the tree, including from other theories (imposition/__init__.py, imposition/semantic/{core,model}.py, exclusion/examples.py, every logos subtheory's operators.py, roughly a dozen test modules). Recommended: begin Phase 18 with a fresh dispatch rather than continuing with reduced context budget.

files_modified: ~24 files across code/ and docs/ with get_theory([...]) -> get_theory(subtheories=[...]) call-site updates
several builder/ and iterate/ README.md files
decisions_made: Adapter attachment is post-hoc via registry.set_adapter(), called from jupyter/adapters.py itself, not passed at theory_lib's register_theory() call time -- avoids theory_lib importing jupyter (upper layer)
Theory-name-to-adapter-class association derived structurally from each adapter class's own '{Name}TheoryAdapter' naming convention, never a hardcoded dict literal

Added a registry-driven default-theory concept (set_default_theory/get_default_theory) not originally scoped to any single phase, needed because several jupyter functions hardcoded theory_name='logos' as both a parameter default and a fallback
Each theory's four lazy registry components share one cache per theory (not one per component), so get_theory() is invoked at most once per theory

theory_lib's _register_theories() is idempotent (not fail-fast) for its own re-execution, observed under pytest --import-mode=importlib re-executing theory_lib/__init__.py's top-level code during isolated single-file collection
Exclusion's WitnessProposition moved into a new proposition.py (not folded into model.py), establishing the core/model/proposition three-file convention Phase 18 will reuse for logos
dead_ends: Do not bulk-substitute get_theory([...]) -> get_theory(subtheories=[...]) across the whole repo without checking which theory's get_theory each call site actually targets -- 5 builder/tests fixture files call bimodal's config-only get_theory with a harmless unused positional placeholder and must NOT receive the subtheories= keyword
